checks.evidence: Dimensioned apartment subassemblies, fasteners, sash/rail/AC detail tooling exists; generated window optics separates two sliding glass leaves from the frame and interior backing instead of relying on one opaque window block. Occupant-controlled curtain dressing is a separate physical layer behind the repeated manufactured sash, with 30 deterministic assemblies, physical LOD0 pleats and LOD0/1/2/3 staging.
Generated detail geometry has a non-razor-edge replacement pass.
Danchi master geometry has explicit LOD staging; the apartment curtain layer independently uses four cross-faded LOD levels so close pleats are not paid at distance.

Root/trunk/branch/twig/leaf hierarchy tooling exists; tree anchors also receive root-zone planting interfaces rather than remaining visually disconnected from the plaza/grass substrate. Static clone-risk QA uses both fine root-normalized hierarchy fingerprints and a coarser perceptual signature that discards generated numeric suffixes and sub-threshold transform jitter, so procedural natural variation cannot pass solely by nudging branches or ecology instances by visually irrelevant amounts.

Two-sided foliage optics and transmission shader are present, with measured-order dielectric F0/GGX constraints and explicit QA. Cause-based understory uses the same thin-leaf optical model and four renderer-distinct cross-faded LOD levels with density reduced toward pedestrian-pressure sources.

Weathering remains driven by rain/splash/drain/contact/UV context rather than arbitrary grime. The facade pass reconstructs grade splash, sill/downpipe runoff, balcony drip residue, sparse rail-fixing rust and AC drain residue as non-colliding source-anchored meshes; vegetation density likewise follows ordinary maintenance/foot-traffic pressure rather than random decoration.

PBR generation includes physical-scale infrastructure micro maps, metre-derived macro/detail base-ground layers, a two-scale non-metallic facade coating, physically separated dielectric glazing, dry non-metallic weathering residue materials, root-zone soil/precast tree-pit materials, transmitted-light foliage, park/street-furniture PBR sets, and curtain-fabric families with textile normal/albedo structure. Active map registration/sampling and actual scene material metallic/specular ranges have dedicated QA.

One deterministic midsummer solar model drives SummerSun, procedural sky sun reference, sky-derived ambient fill and default specular environment. The solar application entry point reapplies the same StableFit/4-cascade/VeryHigh shadow state used by the shadow gate, and a MainCamera Camera.onPreCull guard rejects any second active directional key or shadow-state drift before camera culling. Two 512px HDR local reflection probes use ViaScripting/NoTimeSlicing and BlendProbesAndSkybox. The authoritative pre-capture path now SHA-256 fingerprints the exact physical lighting state before RenderProbe, at every observed EditorApplication.update polling boundary, at probe completion and immediately before still acceptance. The fingerprint covers SummerSun transform/PBR light state, procedural-sky asset/properties, reflection/fog RenderSettings, all 27 ambient SH coefficients, and global shadow/MSAA/LOD/anisotropy state; a mismatch aborts instead of pairing stale local specular with a newer direct/ambient state.

Generated fallbacks remain replaceable by authored FBX/GLB art; facade optics and occupancy variation skip when the danchi authored-art slot is active. Vegetation ecology keys from stable tree-slot anchors, so authored tree replacement does not require moving the surrounding root-zone interface.

Per-component manufacture/material/angular-light-response registry exists, with foundation/grade, facade/glazing, apartment window dressing, environment, reflection synchronization, solar/shadow capture coherence, facade-weathering, vegetation-ecology, scene-repetition and park/street-furniture contracts. Metadata records manufacture, dimensions, mounting, clearances, albedo/roughness/metallic/F0/normal/microstructure/wetness/UV aging/angular response, geometry-vs-material split and LOD policy where applicable.

Dedicated 3840x2160 hero/oblique/grazing capture code with pixel-exact 100% crops rebuilds and saves the detailed benchmark before reflection synchronization. Contextualized scene saves require the solar/shadow pre-cull guard, and Camera.Render reaches the Built-in Render Pipeline pre-cull callback before culling. The complete review packet now explicitly validates the solar contract, fingerprints the exact physical lighting state before realtime probe requests, rechecks the hash on every later Editor poll, requires completed 512px Cube textures plus an identical completion hash, writes a schema-1.1 async proof bound to the completion receipt, and recomputes the same hash immediately before native still capture. QualityBlock4KCapture still owns the display-transform proof itself and refuses runtime-manifest production unless exactly three 3840x2160 filmic passes occurred with zero fallback blits, an observed floating-point HDR source and an observed non-HDR destination. No successful configuration receipt can award visual points.

Capture contract records exact hero/oblique/grazing view/crop paths plus intended sky/reflection state and explicitly remains unrendered until Unity executes it. Reflection synchronization requires a runtime completion receipt plus a fresh schema-1.1 async proof hash-bound to that receipt and to one physical-lighting SHA-256 observed at request, every Editor poll, completion and immediate pre-still validation. The solar/shadow contract independently refuses a second directional key and verifies the deterministic source sample before capture. The native capture path fails before runtime-manifest production if the HDR-tonemap execution proof is absent or invalid. No static check is allowed to clear a critical visual defect.

latestRun.verification: GitHub source/static inspection only; no Unity runner or actual render was available. The audit identified an evidence-integrity gap between the existing solar MainCamera pre-cull guard and asynchronous realtime reflection rendering: the still could be correctly guarded while its already-completed local cubemap had been rendered under a persistently different sun/sky/ambient/shadow state. A new deterministic SHA-256 lighting fingerprint now covers the sole SummerSun rotation, intensity, color temperature/color, shadow mode/resolution/strength/bias/normal-bias/near-plane/culling mask; procedural-sky asset GUID/shader and physical sky properties; RenderSettings ambient/reflection/fog state; every one of the 27 RenderSettings.ambientProbe spherical-harmonic coefficients; and QualitySettings realtime probes, shadow projection/resolution/distance/cascades/splits/near-plane, MSAA, LOD bias/maximum level and anisotropic filtering. QualityBlockReflectionProbeAwaiter records this hash before RenderProbe, recomputes it on every observed EditorApplication.update while RenderIDs are in flight, uses the final matching poll as completion hash, writes both hashes plus poll counts into schema-1.1 async evidence, and requires the same hash again immediately before still acceptance. The first implementation compared only request/completion; self-audit strengthened it to every observed poll and also added omitted per-light shadow resolution plus maximumLOD/aniso fields before recording this run. This still cannot prove a mutation that occurs and fully reverts entirely between observable callbacks, so actual Unity evidence remains mandatory.
expectedVisualScoreImpact: Lighting/shadows/reflections: reduces risk that local metal/glass reflections encode a different direct-sun, sky-fill or global shadow state from the 4K still. No points are awarded until real hero/oblique/grazing pixels are reviewed.
Material/PBR physical plausibility: Fresnel and rough-specular review is now evidence-bound to the same sky/sun/ambient state as the visible frame, reducing false confidence from stale cubemaps.
Cinematic image quality/composition/color/exposure: local specular energy cannot silently come from an earlier sky/reflection state while the frame uses a newer direct/ambient state.
Temporal/LOD/aliasing stability: MSAA, LOD bias, maximum LOD and anisotropy are included in the reflection/still coherence fingerprint, but actual shimmer/pop remains render-only evidence.
Automatic Visual Fidelity impact: 0 points. Source-only hash coherence is an evidence-integrity prerequisite, not observed image quality.
